titles.title: DEPOTS Act
Defense Expenditure Planning for Optimizing Throughput and Sustainment Act of 2026
DEPOTS Act

A bill to authorize the Secretary of Defense to eliminate any internal Department of Defense depreciated costs or cancel any internal Department debts associated with depots and arsenal from accounts of a military department or the Department that are associated with certain capital expenditures that no longer generate revenue due to mission changes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Armed Services.
